`n/a` means the arm or selection did not exist before the composable gate.

| `package` | 17.67 | 12.87 | passed | `uv build` |
| `render` | n/a | 11.65 | passed | `uv run python scripts/build_manuscript.py --render pdf` |

Baseline workloads that are not equivalent to their arms:

- `types`: The baseline mypy run targeted Python 3.12; the arm now targets the requires-python floor (3.11).
- `test-full`: The baseline was `uv run pytest` without `--cov` or `--cov-fail-under=90`; the arm runs coverage. Recorded result: 84 passed, 1 skipped.
- `docs`: The baseline ran only the link/anchor checker; the arm also verifies the generated metrics document.
- `manuscript`: The baseline ran validation, build, and the build check; the arm also verifies the generated variables file.

Baseline conditions: One manual run per command before the composable gate landed, on the same host. Other estate jobs drove the load average to about 100 and all caches were warm, so these are historical evidence, not a controlled benchmark.

The baseline and current receipts are historical evidence. Timings include host load and warm caches; they are not a controlled benchmark.
